configuration.seed_rule: 20261109 + task_index; same task seed as the two preceding SR algorithms

symbolic_regression.selection: Lowest public training MSE; initial affine seed may win; no ID/OOD selection.
symbolic_regression.adaptation: Official pipeline.main/buffer/evaluator/sampler with transport injection and restricted mathematical AST interpreter; not unrestricted Python search.

data_provenance: Reuse frozen Core80 data; Thermoelastic 030/046/054/062/070/078 imported unchanged from collaborator; generating environment/time unknown. No regeneration.

result_selection.policy: One attempt per task; import every existing performance.json including invalid results. No placeholders for missing performance; terminal evidence in summary provenance.

metrics.P: symbolic phenomenal task pass / all planned tasks
metrics.paper_task_SA_M: all planned probes symbolically pass / all planned tasks
metrics.legacy_probe_M: symbolically passing probes / all planned probes
metrics.missing_policy: Zero contribution in aggregates only; native errors/nulls are preserved.
metrics.numeric_warning: Native numerically_equivalent is not the paper Acc_0.1 metric.
